items.title: 61529_Maxine Sullivan oral history interview
items.q: Boots Swan. She was the most popular singer around Pittsburgh. She was the competition that nobody could get a job around Boots Swan.

ctx.x: What kind of style did they play?
I would say that they were playing, more or less, boogie-woogie, you know, real jazz. There were entertainers that would show up, Boots Swan was the . . .
